title: The Shed Antler
text: An antler as long as a man lies in the bracken, freshly shed, the root still bloody. The quarry is near, and lighter now, and angry with the ache of it. Its tracks lead off through the trees, deep and fresh.

outcomes.text: Wyrmbone, or near enough, and still warm at the root.

options.label: The craftiest uses it as bait.

outcomes.text: The quarry comes back for it, and finds you waiting.

options.label: The sharpest eye follows the fresh trail.

outcomes.text: Close now. You can hear it.
